title: The free tracial post-Lie-Rinehart algebra of planar aromatic trees for the design of divergence-free Lie-group methods
summary: Aromatic Butcher series were successfully introduced for the study and design of numerical integrators that preserve volume while solving differential equations in Euclidean spaces. They are naturally associated to pre-Lie-Rinehart algebras and pre-Hopf algebroids structures, and aromatic trees were shown to form the free tracial pre-Lie-Rinehart algebra. In this paper, we present the generalisation of aromatic trees for the study of divergence-free integrators on manifolds.
